items.title: Replace HVAC filter
items.description: Every season, sooner with pets. A clogged filter is the most common cause of a struggling system.

items.title: HVAC service
items.description: Spring and fall — before the cooling and heating seasons.

items.title: Clean gutters
items.description: Spring and fall. Overflowing gutters send water into the foundation.

items.title: Smoke & CO detector batteries
items.description: Replace the batteries and press the test button on every unit.

items.title: Flush water heater
items.description: Drains the sediment that shortens the tank's life and its efficiency.

items.title: Clean dryer vent
items.description: Lint in the duct is a fire risk, not just a slow dryer.

items.title: Refrigerator water filter
items.description: Or per the fridge's own indicator.

items.title: Sprinkler blowout
items.description: Before the first freeze, if the house has an irrigation system.

items.title: Chimney sweep & inspection
items.description: If the house has a wood-burning fireplace or stove. Creosote is a fire risk.

items.title: Septic pump-out
items.description: If the house is on septic. Every three to five years depending on household size.
